items.title: The Milwaukee #Bucks had a walkthrough-type practice today. Head coach Taylor Jenkins said Jaime Jaquez Jr. tweaked an ankle last night against Indiana, but appears to be OK. They'll keep an eye on it through shootaround tomorrow before playing Houston.
items.author: Jim Owczarski
items.body_excerpt: The Milwaukee #Bucks had a walkthrough-type practice today. Head coach Taylor Jenkins said Jaime Jaquez Jr. tweaked an ankle last night against Indiana, but appears to be OK. They'll keep an eye on it through shootaround tomorrow before playing Houston.
